name: ship-u-ship
summary: Player ship: a U-shaped band standing on edge, open end forward, with a brown bell-shaped pod hung in the middle on two short struts; hard-surface ribbon and pod.

traits: bell-shaped, round at the front (row 12), flat at the back (row 20)
round in section, about as tall as wide
features.note: The pod in the middle of the U; must read as a rounded bell, not a flat plate.

traits: dark glass at the pod's front (rows 13-14)
features.note: The dark window on the front of the pod.

traits: pale stripe down the left of the pod (column 10, rows 16-19)
features.note: The pale stripe that shows the pod is round.
The shaded groove down the right side of the pod.

traits: tall thin ribbon standing on edge
grey with dark joint bands at rows 14 and 19
features.note: The left arm of the U (column 5, rows 7-21): a tall flat band, not a low rail.

traits: tall thin ribbon standing on edge
grey with dark joint bands at rows 14 and 19
features.note: The right arm of the U (column 17).

traits: smooth half ellipse joining the arms
features.note: The back of the U, curving round behind the pod (rows 20-25), brown.
The two short struts that hang the pod from the arms.

concept.source: Gemini (Nano Banana) high-res reimagining of the level-frame sprite, 2026-10-28, with the user's prompt (same overhead outline, don't take pixels literally)
concept.use: Design guide for what each part is and its shape language; the sprite decides the top-view outline, proportions and colours.
